steps.content:
**Buy from Ottervale Audio (seller A).** It costs $129, against $194 at Brackmoor Sound. That is $65 less for what looks like the same product.

| | Ottervale Audio (A) | Brackmoor Sound (B) |
|---|---|---|
| Price | **$129.00** | $194.00 |
| Shipping | Free, 3–5 business days | Free, 3–5 business days |
| Returns | 30 days, buyer pays return shipping | Same |
| Warranty | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| Rating | 4.3 (210 reviews) | 4.3 (210 reviews) |
| Specs and box contents | Identical | Identical |

**Why A:**
- Shipping, returns, warranty, specs and box contents are the same on both pages.
- The only real differences are the price and one line of wording.

**The one caveat:** Brackmoor describes itself as an "Authorized Quellwyn dealer" with "Full manufacturer warranty." Ottervale makes no such claim. That could matter if you want to be sure the unit is genuine and the warranty is honored by Quellwyn. But Brackmoor's own warranty section also says "1-year limited warranty," the same as Ottervale's. I don't see a concrete benefit that justifies $65 more.

**Before you buy from Ottervale:**
- If the authorized-dealer status matters to you, check Ottervale's about or contact page. You could also ask Quellwyn whether Ottervale is an authorized reseller.
- The two listings show identical ratings and review counts (4.3 from 210 reviews). They may be sharing one product-level review pool, so they don't tell you anything about the sellers themselves. Look for seller-specific feedback if you can.

If you'd pay a premium for certainty about authenticity and warranty coverage, Brackmoor is the safer choice. Otherwise, Ottervale is the better deal.
